reuse.why: All four steps go through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection and averageToBudget sign helper; the new action uses both plus getSheetValue and setBudget.

duplication.why: Template, #fixed and hidden rules are each written once inside the shared selection; no action re-filters categories itself.

placement.why: Exclusion rules live in the bulk-action selection in budget/actions.ts; the new action and its registration sit beside their siblings.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the bulk actions, their selection helper, the handler registration, a test and release notes.

maintainability.why: The helper stays a single documented definition with a small option set (skipMissingGroup for the preserved missing-group difference, includeHiddenCategories for the requested option), replacing the old setZero-specific includeHidden flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, takes its categories from getBulkBudgetCategories.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories (replacing the earlier includeHidden flag, so the option count is unchanged); the template and #fixed checks are general rules applied to every caller, not per-caller special cases; no call site bypasses the helper.
